publication_chronology.status: Release-time presentation of an earlier internal plan; not external preregistration.
publication_chronology.known_at_plan_time: Existing development findings and the small two-draw seed-0 label-budget pilot.
publication_chronology.hash_scope: Original digests identify the retained internal records. This sanitised presentation has different bytes and is not backdated as a public registration.
publication_chronology.clarification: Inherited 548-image/development-selection metadata was explicitly nonoperative for test-dev before acquisition. All official test-dev images were included; numerical settings were unchanged.

question: Do the frozen development inference-setting contrasts persist on official DET test-dev, held out from this study?

seed0.training: Existing 150-epoch 640-input YOLO11n training; no test-dev training.

seed1.training: Existing 150-epoch 640-input YOLO11n training; no test-dev training.

seed2.training: Existing 150-epoch 640-input YOLO11n training; no test-dev training.

inference.candidate_policy: single highest-scoring class per proposal (DetectionPredictor multi_label=False); differs from multi-label training validation
inference.timing_boundary: JPEG read/decode through CPU output predictions; includes view construction, model preprocessing/inference/postprocessing, device transfers and CPU tile merge; artifact writing and metric calculation excluded

window_and_geometry.window_order: y starts then x starts; step floor(640*(1-0.2)); append final max(0,extent-640) start when absent; truncate window extent at image boundary.
window_and_geometry.projection: Clip crop-local xyxy to crop dimensions, discard zero-area boxes, then add crop origin into original-image coordinates.
window_and_geometry.merge: CPU torchvision class-aware batched_nms at IoU 0.7 followed by confidence-ordered cap 1000.
window_and_geometry.record_order: Canonical source-image order; rotate method execution by image index. Saved prediction rows remain globally confidence sorted.
window_and_geometry.float_policy: FP32 model inference; float32 boxes/IoUs for the pinned matcher; retained tie/order behaviour follows the recorded source/runtime.

metric.name: Pinned converted ten-class pooled AP50-95
metric.units: percent; contrasts in AP percentage points
metric.pooling: Pool detections/GT by class over all images before pinned precision-recall/AP and class/IoU aggregation; not mean per-image AP.
metric.source_identity_note: Executed and bundled source identities are separate; public licence headers and packaging can change bytes. No executable test-dev adapter is supplied.

primary_contrasts: full_1280 minus full_960 APpp for each checkpoint
full_1280 minus fixed_slices_640_plus_global APpp for each checkpoint
full four-setting AP table for each checkpoint
frozen_choices: No retraining, checkpoint reselection, confidence/NMS/resolution/tile tuning or learned selector on test-dev.
secondary_scope: Development six-convention, native/publisher reference, current-matcher, size and label-budget controls are not test-dev results.
failure_policy: Retain outcomes and failures; correct provenance/data issues before scoring; no favourable subset or threshold selection.

inference_adapter.distribution_scope: Execution identity only. This repository does not include the private test-dev adapter or a portable executable test-dev branch.

uncertainty: Descriptive same-checkpoint contrasts across different image splits; no population significance, scene-independent interval or causal attribution of score drop.
